name: research-report
description: A research report, findings memo or landscape survey judged against the sources it rests on. Four seats, four named distinct families, no Claude seat: fidelity in claim-by-claim fact-check mode, source-credibility on whether those sources deserve the weight, completeness on what the report never covered, and adversarial on whether its conclusion survives. `verify_web` is off in v1, so fidelity and source-credibility judge the supplied sources rather than the live web — a report whose sources are not supplied cannot be reviewed by this panel.
